prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Empoleon (엠페르트) personified, water / steel type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: one brow raised higher, head tilted, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted
Pose: Carry the scene's bag, basket or box with believable hand contact and weight.
Orientation: front three-quarter body turn of about 30-45 degrees; rotate torso and pelvis together
Scene: In an empty covered morning produce market, she compares one yellow pear with a blue berry held above a woven shopping basket; blank wooden crates have no signs.
Outfit and props: A white open-collar elbow-sleeve hip-length shirt tucked into separate navy calf-length pleated culottes, a cropped yellow cardigan layered open, flat navy shoes and a small gold trident bracelet charm.
Category: Create candid ordinary personal-life moments. The scene should feel lived-in, believable, and visually specific rather than staged. Use normal contemporary clothing with clear character personality. Avoid glamour-shoot posing, professional work, and costume styling.
Example scene: Grocery Run
Note: LOCAL ACCESSORY CORRECTION: image 1 supplies identity; edit image 2. Remove only the blue-and-gold pointed armor hair ornament above her right ear, leaving plain flowing navy hair. Keep her face, hands, fruits, basket, outfit, pose, market and framing exactly as image 2.
Framing: Environmental long shot: show the complete woman and enough surroundings to establish the activity and location.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
source_influence: balanced — a few source color and marking cues integrated into everyday clothing
separates_preference: strongly prefer separates — use separate top and bottom by default; explicit outfit takes priority

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers of natural length, clearly separated, never merged, doubled or extra.
